page.overview:
Who is Gilda Stahl?

Gilda Stahl is a non-canon character that made her only appearance in the Mortal Kombat novel. She was introduced as a female member of the Black Dragon who travels with Kano, and was nicknamed "Gilly". It turns out that "Gilda" was a disguise used by Special Forces agent Sonya Blade to try to apprehend Kano.
